# Yes, Garmin smartwatches work with your phone


September 29, 2026


### *Keep in touch, get added peace of mind, and monitor your health and wellness when you pair your smartwatch to your smartphone*


We all keep a close eye on our smartphone notifications to stay connected to family, friends and whoever else might need to get ahold of us. But you don’t always need to be glued to your phone to stay connected. With a Garmin smartwatch, you can keep an eye on your notifications without your phone ever leaving your pocket.


## Staying connected


Compatible with either your Apple® or Android™ smartphone, you can get a lot when you pair with a Garmin smartwatch. In addition to[next-level battery life](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/general/how-long-will-my-garmin-smartwatch-battery-last/) , activity profiles for just about any sport and advanced physiological data tracking, your Garmin smartwatch makes it easy to stay connected to what matters with a flick of the wrist.


## Receive notifications


Any notification you allow, such as texts, calls, calendar reminders and emails, will go from your phone straight to your watch. If you have an Android, you can even respond directly to messages from select watches using our predetermined response options. And select smartwatches, like[Venu® 4](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1613801/) , come with a built-in speaker and mic so you can take and make calls from your watch or use your paired smartphone’s voice assistant to send text messages, ask questions and more.


## Find your phone


Skip the panicked feeling you get when you realize your phone isn’t on you. Instead, use your connected Garmin smartwatch to sound an alarm from your phone with the Find My Phone feature. Follow the sound and quickly track your device down.


## Added peace of mind


Garmin smartwatch users can use[LiveTrack™](https://support.garmin.com/en-US/?faq=HbqxxbiBGA3mDhlLX4GUw8) , fall detection1 (only on Venu 4),[incident detection1](https://support.garmin.com/en-US/?faq=RfaXahBWkH8Q7pVFLsuUmA) and the[assistance feature](https://support.garmin.com/en-US/?faq=Ots03L9cFf98el3a0ioSk9) to help provide peace of mind for family and friends.


LiveTrack keeps a real-time view of your location during a GPS activity so your preselected contacts can see where you are when you venture out for your next jog. If you choose to share the information with them, they’ll be able to see your current location, the duration of the activity, the distance you’ve traveled, your heart rate and more. Learn more about[LiveTrack on our support page.](https://support.garmin.com/en-US/?faq=HbqxxbiBGA3mDhlLX4GUw8)


For all-day or activity-specific monitoring, Venu 4 users can enable fall detection1. If your Venu 4 smartwatch detects a fall, it can send a message1 with your live location (if available) to designated assistance contacts.


With incident detection, an automated message including your name and GPS location (if available) will be sent to designated assistance contacts if your watch detects an incident. To utilize this feature, pair the Garmin Connect™ app with your smartphone.


Those in need of help can manually activate the assistance feature. Whether you’re in the middle of an activity or not, you can manually notify your designated assistance contacts with a message that includes your name, LiveTrack link and GPS location (if available).


[Garmin smartwatches that include inReach® connectivity](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/wearables-smartwatches/?FILTER_FEATURE_CELL_SATELLITE_CONNECTIVITY=true&currentPage=1) for LTE and satellite coverage allow users to communicate with loved ones back home2. Once connected to the LTE network, send up to 30-second voice messages as well as make or answer phone calls from your smartwatch to users with a compatible smartwatch or those who are[Garmin Messenger™ app](https://www.garmin.com/p/893837) users. For support from[Garmin Response](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/outdoor/get-to-know-garmin-response/) ℠, a 24/7 international emergency coordination center2, activate an SOS alert on your smartwatch or Garmin Messenger app.


## Tracking your health and fitness


Garmin Connect also includes your health and fitness data in one place so you can easily view the metrics your watch is tracking and access additional features such as Garmin Coach plans and workouts. Plus, help meet your nutrition goals through tracking and logging with a Garmin Connect+ plan.


Ready to stay connected without staring at your phone screen all day? Explore[Garmin smartwatch offerings](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/wearables-smartwatches/) to find the wearable that’s meant for you.


1When paired with your smartphone; see Garmin.com/ble. For safety and tracking feature requirements and limitations, see Garmin.com/safety.


2Active plan required; LTE network coverage is not available in all regions. Satellite connection and SOS functionality on this device have important limitations compared to other inReach devices that could affect the performance of connected features, making them unavailable in certain situations. Check[Garmin.com/](http://garmin.com/) fenix9profeaturerequirements for requirements and limitations and to see which services are accessible in your area — or in areas to where you may be traveling to ensure the performance, coverage and service levels of this device are suitable for your intended use.
